target: Spoiler-free 100% completion: all connections, collectibles, orders, infrastructure, fabrication, activities, and campaign completion

areas.name: Completion Planner
areas.location_cue: At any delivery terminal or private-room map before choosing the next route.
areas.note: This route avoids unnecessary grinding before all completion systems are available.

levels.1: Build the network and collect nearby discoveries as each region opens.
levels.2: Connect every terminal you encounter, read new mail after resting, and keep a manual list of unfinished delivery and fabrication menus.
levels.3: There is no permanently missable completion content and free roam remains available. During the campaign, connect visible terminals, take hidden-recipient cargo when found, pick up nearby chips, and build roads. Leave the heavy five-star, premium-rank, fabrication, and all-order cleanup for the post-campaign map when every route and email gate is available.

levels.1: Only premium delivery grades care about the selected difficulty.
levels.2: Use any setting for campaign progress; switch to Hard or Very Hard before accepting premium Standard Orders.
levels.3: No campaign difficulty clear is required. Hard permits Legend of Legends grades and Very Hard permits Legend of Legends of Legends. Select the difficulty before accepting a Premium Delivery, complete twenty unique orders in each of the four delivery categories at the qualifying S rank, and lower the setting again whenever no premium counter is being attempted.

levels.1: Resting and reading mail is part of completion, not optional flavor.
levels.2: Whenever a connection meter or collectible spawn stalls, make one delivery, rest in a private room, and read every unread message.
levels.3: Reluctant shelters release connection caps only after specific mail, and several chips spawn only after their hint message is opened. Hand in one cargo item, rest, read the new mail, then repeat instead of banking many deliveries at once. Continue even after five stars when waiting for the Paleontologist's chip message.

levels.1: The open map is the safest place for the long completion sweep.
levels.2: After campaign completion, finish every star meter, chip, unique order, premium category, structure type, fabrication checkbox, and Director's Cut activity.
levels.3: Use fast travel between regions, complete the mountain zip-line network, and inspect Bridge Links plus Data menus. Confirm every star-rated facility is at five, every network-only endpoint is connected, every chip is decrypted, all fabrication entries show their produced checkmark, all structure types were built and upgradeable types reached level three, and all finite Director's Cut drills and races are complete.

areas.name: Orders and Delivery Grades
areas.location_cue: The order-selection screen at any connected delivery terminal and the delivery statistics in Bridge Links.

levels.1: Check the Orders for Sam tab whenever a terminal or email gains a marker.
levels.2: Complete every available gold-strand and optional Order for Sam, including Director's Cut and crossover chains.
levels.3: At each terminal, clear every Orders for Sam entry rather than only mandatory ones. Rest and read mail to expose follow-ups. levels.1: A completed order can reappear, so distinguish a first completion from a repeat.
levels.2: Complete every distinct Standard Order from every active terminal at least once.
levels.3: Use the terminal origin list and Bridge Links delivery records to track first-time completions. Director's Cut contains 540 distinct Standard Orders across the eastern and central maps; repeated orders still give likes but do not advance the unique checklist. Some orders appear only after earlier orders, connection levels, or mail, so revisit all terminals after five-star cleanup.

levels.1: Ordinary terminal work has a smaller cumulative completion check.
levels.2: Complete at least thirty-six Standard Orders.
levels.3: Accept Standard Orders from any terminal and finish thirty-six successfully. Unique orders used for the full Standard Order sweep and premium work also satisfy this baseline; failed or abandoned deliveries do not.

levels.1: Choose deliveries whose icon emphasizes careful handling.
levels.2: Earn a qualifying S rank on twenty unique premium Cargo Condition orders.
levels.3: Set the game to Hard or Very Hard before acceptance and enable Premium Delivery. Protect the containers with careful routes and repair spray, then secure the difficulty's highest delivery grade. Repeat with twenty distinct condition-category orders; re-running one order does not add another unique result.

levels.1: Large consignments favor trucks and completed roads.
levels.2: Earn a qualifying S rank on twenty unique premium Delivery Volume orders.
levels.3: Choose volume-icon orders, load the complete consignment into a truck, and use roads where possible. On Hard earn Legend of Legends, or on Very Hard earn Legend of Legends of Legends, for twenty different volume orders.

levels.1: Timed work becomes much easier after roads and mountain zip-lines are ready.
levels.2: Earn a qualifying S rank on twenty unique premium Delivery Time orders.
levels.3: Accept timed premium orders only after plotting a road, vehicle, or zip-line route. Use Hard for Legend of Legends or Very Hard for Legend of Legends of Legends, beat the premium time on twenty distinct timed orders, and verify the category counter in Bridge Links.

levels.1: Retrieval and unusual-condition orders fill the fourth premium category.
levels.2: Earn a qualifying S rank on twenty unique premium Miscellaneous orders.
levels.3: Select premium orders with the miscellaneous icon, satisfy every retrieval or special condition, and return all required cargo. Accumulate qualifying S ranks on twenty different orders while playing Hard or Very Hard.

levels.1: Balance order categories instead of letting one grade absorb all the likes.
levels.2: Raise Cargo Condition, Delivery Volume, Delivery Time, Miscellaneous, and Bridge Link to grade sixty.
levels.3: Inspect Bridge Links for the five separate grades. Use the matching order icon to raise each delivery grade, and online likes, shared structures, supply requests, and entrusted cargo for Bridge Link. Continue until every category reads at least 60.

levels.1: Large multi-piece consignments advance an item counter quickly.
levels.2: Deliver seven hundred individual cargo pieces.
levels.3: Complete ordinary and premium orders with many separate containers until the delivery-results statistics show at least 700 cargo items delivered. Container count matters here, not total weight.

levels.1: Heavy farm and material deliveries advance a different record.
levels.2: Deliver a cumulative three thousand kilograms of cargo.
levels.3: Use trucks for dense material and farm consignments, complete the delivery normally, and continue until the statistics exceed 3,000 kg. Weight and item count are separate counters.

levels.1: A long-running distance counter completes only when followed by a successful order.
levels.2: Travel at least eighty kilometers, then complete any order.
levels.3: Normal movement across the campaign accumulates the distance. Once Bridge Links shows at least 80 km traveled, finish and submit one valid order so the completion check evaluates.

levels.1: Let an automated unit finish one low-risk Standard Order.
levels.2: Dispatch a delivery bot on a Standard Order and wait for its result.
levels.3: At a terminal with bot access, open Standard Orders (Bots), choose a route with a favorable predicted condition, dispatch it, and complete another delivery or rest until the bot returns. Open the results screen to register completion.

levels.1: Blue-tagged cargo on the ground belongs to another recipient.
levels.2: Return at least one piece of Lost Cargo to its named destination.
levels.3: Scan outside facilities, pick up cargo marked Lost, inspect its intended recipient, and deliver it to that exact terminal. Entrusting it elsewhere does not count as personally completing the return.

levels.1: Recheck the western distribution center in the eastern region after its early retrieval orders.

levels.1: New equipment adds a matching practice drill.

levels.3: Enter Firing Range from a distribution-center, safe-house, or private-room terminal. levels.1: A post-delivery email points to an Auto-Paver south of the farm.
levels.2: Contribute the required materials to the racetrack terminal south of Timefall Farm.
levels.3: After the racetrack message arrives, deliver 650 chiral crystals, 2,240 metals, and 1,960 ceramics to its terminal. Online contributions reduce what remains. Confirm the track menu opens before beginning race cleanup.

levels.1: Each vehicle class has its own set of courses and permanent rewards.
levels.2: Complete all twelve races and earn S rank in every Reverse Trike, Roadster, and Truck race.
levels.3: Finish all twelve finite races once to receive the completion patch. Earn S in all four Reverse Trike races for its hologram, any Roadster race for the Roadster blueprint, all four Roadster races for the Long Range blueprint and hologram, and all four Truck races for its hologram.

levels.1: The online ranked board rotates rather than forming a permanent finite checklist.
levels.2: Complete at least one available Ranked Order, Drill, and Race while each activity is online.
levels.3: Open Ranked Orders from the cuff link, a Firing Range terminal, and the completed racetrack. levels.1: The fabrication description contains a small produced-before checkbox.
levels.2: Unlock and fabricate every weapon, equipment item, and vehicle variant in the Director's Cut menu.
levels.3: Inspect every fabrication tile and produce each one until its lower-corner checkbox is marked. The complete Director's Cut menu contains 108 required entries. levels.1: New mail arrives after deliveries and private-room rests.

levels.3: Raise facilities, complete optional and Standard Orders, then open Data > Interviews and read every unseen entry. Continue delivery cleanup until at least one hundred have been opened.

levels.1: Safe traversal and calm recovery steadily improve the companion bond.
levels.2: Raise BB's connection meter to its maximum level.
levels.3: Avoid repeated falls and danger, soothe BB whenever crying, rest in private rooms, use hot springs, play the harmonica while resting, and trigger positive interactions. Inspect Bridge Links until the BB connection displays five stars.

levels.1: The online request menu can ask another porter for equipment.
levels.2: Issue one supply request from the cuff-link menu.
levels.3: Open Cuff Links > Supply Requests, select any unlocked item and destination structure or facility, then confirm the request. The request only needs to be issued; another player need not fulfill it.

levels.1: Shared lockers accept useful fabricated gear.
levels.2: Donate one weapon or equipment item to a share locker.
levels.3: At a facility or Postbox, open Share Locker > Donate Weapons & Equipment, select an eligible item, and confirm the donation.

levels.1: Friendly porters sometimes travel in pairs near connected facilities.
levels.2: Exchange cargo with an NPC porter.
levels.3: Approach a nonhostile porter without a weapon drawn, give repeated likes, place a carried item on the ground when prompted by their behavior, and accept the item they offer. Complete both halves of the exchange.

levels.1: Other connected players can answer a call even when unseen.
levels.2: Send a shout and receive a response.
levels.3: While online in connected territory, use the call-out input near active shared structures or another player's route and repeat occasionally until an unseen porter answers audibly.

levels.1: Use shared structures and signs instead of treating the world as single-player only.
levels.2: Give a manual like and receive at least one like from another source.
levels.3: Stand beside another player's structure, cargo, or sign and use the Like input; then build or place something useful, deliver entrusted cargo, or interact positively with BB until an incoming like registers.

levels.1: A fully disabled camp becomes safe for ordinary porters temporarily.
levels.2: Neutralize every opponent in one MULE or terrorist area.
levels.3: Use nonlethal equipment, scan the camp perimeter, disable every occupant including patrols, and wait for the on-screen notice that ordinary porters can pass through safely. Leaving one distant patrol active prevents completion.

levels.2: Approach an unaware BT and cut its umbilical cord.
levels.3: Equip no noisy weapon, crouch and hold breath while approaching an exposed cord after the cuff upgrade becomes available, then use the cut prompt before detection. Escape the immediate area after the cord dissolves.

levels.1: Resting on safe open ground can restore minor damage.

levels.3: Reach safe terrain, hold the rest input, then choose Sleep. Remain still until health or stamina recovery begins; a private-room transition is a different interaction.

levels.1: Private rooms contain a player for unlocked tracks.
levels.2: Play one unlocked song from a private room.
levels.3: Enter any private room, interact with the music player, choose an available track, and let playback begin.

levels.1: Keep a spare pair on the boot clip before the current set fails.
levels.2: Equip a different pair of boots from carried cargo.
levels.3: Carry spare footwear, open the cargo menu, select the spare pair, and equip it. Merely moving boots onto the boot clip does not change the worn pair.

levels.1: A bodily-function interaction exists outside facilities.
levels.2: Urinate once in valid open terrain.
levels.3: Leave restricted facility space, equip the urination action from the equipment wheel, face clear ground, and hold the use input until the interaction completes.
